decision: CHANGES REQUIRED: deterministic INVOKER/private-helper ACL regression

findings.problem: SECURITY INVOKER trigger successors call private SECURITY DEFINER validators unconditionally before the original legacy branch; only account_owner and ontology_writer receive EXECUTE. A console_rt legacy policy_roles/user_role_assignments INSERT, direct retained legacy Ontology write, and common Rust audit insertion can encounter permission denied before the preserved branch. The source-level failure is confirmed by SQL owner; runtime reproduction not yet reviewed.
findings.evidence: Existing Identity adapter-postgres src/lib.rs1133/1619 directly writes legacy roles/assignments. Original identity root guard returns normally for LEGACY_USER; successor first calls helper to which runtime has no grant. Common audit insert uses runtime role; public.company_enrollment_ontology_audit_guard_v2 is also INVOKER and unconditionally calls audit_admit.
findings.required_fix: Preserve exact original legacy execution path and caller semantics while handing only genuinely new native participants/events to independently enforced always-on guards. Do not grant private helper execution broadly or switch invoker guards to definer in a way that changes old current_user checks. Review frozen round2 and actual restricted-role legacy/audit positive controls.

verified_source_properties: New input/terminal tables both ENABLE+FORCE RLS with same Company USING/WITH CHECK; no raw serving grants in closed ACL. Only private registration-integrity helper retains row_security=off from the original no-serving-execute Account verifier.

Two-commit protocol: A creates immutable accepted input; B requires different xid and original retained bytes; immutable guards cover UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE. Already-terminal replay precedes expected-head/time operation checks.

Foreign uniqueness normalization inspects exact schema/table/PK diagnostics; quota excludes just-created candidate and maintains16/256 caps. Capacity traverses existing private enrollment roster without foreign authority locks and restores transaction-local GUC on normal/exception exit.

Source material obtains Group then sorted Account/family/designation/Company/catalog locks, binds actual actor/current session/deployment and original birth provenance, and rejects changed lock plan. It does not equate current operator to birth operator.

No INSERT INTO audit_events exists in the16-file successor. Audit validation binds actual actor/Company/session via input or terminal, exact payload, time and transaction/backend; deferred closure demands actual events, same-xid evidence, exact effects and rollback on missing proof.

Current Payroll reader appends actual selected assignment valid_from/valid_until and uses current clock; full18field roster derives from registered manifest/current clauses, not UUID ordering or permanent role interval.

All9 original guard fallback bodies mechanically compared byte-for-byte after stripping only new early branch/function naming. The ACL bug demonstrates that textual body preservation alone is insufficient behavior preservation.
Canonical decoder uses exact existing prefix, lengths, integer revisions and minute-aligned bounded signed microseconds; no historical input reinterpretation.
remaining_acceptance: Frozen round2 R1 correction and independent rereview
